name: connectwise-automate
description: ConnectWise Automate (RMM): computers, clients, and read/write escape hatches to the Automate REST API.
long_description:
ConnectWise Automate (RMM) as a local MCP server. Search and read computers, list clients, and reach any other Automate endpoint through cw_automate_api_request (GET only) and cw_automate_api_write.

Every tool is named cw_automate_* and shows a Title Case name in the client. Read-only tools carry readOnlyHint; the write escape hatch refuses every call without confirm: true.

This bundle runs on your own machine and holds the Automate credentials there. PSA and Control ship as separate bundles from the same repository.

tools.name: Get Automate Computer
tools.description: Get one Automate agent in full detail

tools.name: Automate API Request
tools.description: GET any Automate endpoint that has no dedicated tool

tools.name: Automate API Write
tools.description: POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE an Automate endpoint, acting on live RMM agents — writes to ConnectWise

automate_password.title: Automate password
automate_password.description: Automate account password. Supply it from your secret manager.

automate_client_id.description: Automate developer clientId GUID, sent with every Automate request.
